scope: Casting to a macOS AirPlay Receiver with airplay2-cli: discovery, pairing, the diagnosis of the start failure, and the URL-controls fallback with scheduled controls (runs A-C). Observer answers are recorded separately from telemetry. Periodic 'notification keys=type,name,item' events are omitted from the run lines.

findings: The Mac rejects the remote-control SETUP with 500 after a successful pair-verify; the URL session alone plays.
Pairing and the base SETUP wait for an on-screen consent; unanswered, the Mac returns 400 after about 15 s.
setRate 0/1 pause and resume; status extrapolation matched the Mac's reported position (8.9 vs 8.892 s).
The natural end reports the final position (131.567 s) then stopped: media_end.
seek as /command (with and without kind/messageID), legacy /scrub and Start-Position-Seconds are accepted and ignored.
